answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover. Each identity's reputation is escrowed with a long horizon and only unlocks after it survives a random audit of its interaction history. A clone starts at zero reputation, so every fabricated identity must first pay the real cost of generating auditable history before it can transact. The audit cost per clone exceeds any gain from one fable of legitimacy, making cloning strictly negative-EV. Honest agents amortize the same voyage across many interactions.
